title: Any plan to release macOS version?
author: kaansengul
body_snippet: As the source code using .NET 10, maybe it is good idea to release macOS version?

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the suggestion — it's a reasonable thought now that we're on .NET 10, but a native macOS build isn't feasible for mRemoteNG, and the .NET version isn't what's blocking it. The UI and protocol stack are:

- **Windows Forms** (`System.Windows.Forms`) + the WeifenLuo docking framework + a lot of Win32 P/Invoke. WinForms is Windows-only — Microsoft ships it in .NET 10 as a Windows desktop technology with no macOS implementation.
- **RDP is the Windows RDP ActiveX control** (`MSTSCLib` / `...

notes: macOS infeasible: WinForms + MSTSCLib COM RDP ActiveX are Win32-only; .NET 10 alone does not port
